notes.title: Little Warriors Team 1.1.3 Update Details
notes.content:
1. New dungeon gameplay - BOSS Trial
2. Adjust some daily tasks to reduce the difficulty of completion
3. Fix the issue where the character interface cannot be closed

notes.title: Little Warriors Team 1.1.2 Version Update Details
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue of player registration and login failure in some regions, allowing players to choose different routes to log in to the game
2. Reduce the number of monsters in the virus crisis instance, decrease lag, and slightly increase monster attacks and health
3. Reduce the pursuit range of monsters in the vampire castle instance
4. Adjust the planting position, now supporting direct clicking on fields or plants for planting and harvesting
5. New test damage wooden stake, located at the nine o'clock direction of the town, with a stake attribute of 5000 health, 0 attack, and 20 defense
6. Optimize the description of some skills and describe the effects of adding new states in the description
7. Fixed the reset issue of arena challenge count and point rewards
